senses.definition: To prove (something) to be false or incorrect.
senses.example: After we came out of the church, we stood talking for some time together of Bishop Berkeley's ingenious sophistry to prove the non-existence of matter, and that every thing in the universe is merely ideal. I observed, that though we are satisfied his doctrine is not true, it is impossible to refute it. I never shall forget the alacrity with which Johnson answered, striking his foot with mighty force against a large stone, till he rebounded from it, "I refute it thus."

senses.definition: To deny the truth or correctness of (something); to reject or disagree with an accusation.
senses.example: A spokesperson for VARS Technology said: “We completely refute the suggestion that our market-leading ANPR system is unreliable".
